codes.message: Color encodings must have redundant channels per RDV.4 Section 4.1.
codes.cause: A color field has neither a redundant shape or detail channel nor a ready table column.
codes.fix: Add a redundant channel or a ready table fallback containing the color field.

codes.message: Size channels must remain perceptible (Δarea ≥ 1.5×) to satisfy RDV.4 glyph guidance.
codes.cause: A size channel lacks enough numeric values or a perceptible positive magnitude range.
codes.fix: Use a different encoding when the data cannot support a positive size range of at least 1.5 times.

codes.message: Accessible table fallback must be available for every spec.
codes.cause: No ready accessible table can be generated for the chart.
codes.fix: Provide readable rows and a supported table fallback for the chart data.

codes.message: Category comparisons (bar/stacked) require narrative summaries of extrema.
codes.cause: A bar chart has no narrative summary or no finding describing its extrema.
codes.fix: Provide a narrative summary and at least one finding describing the bar values.

codes.message: Positional encodings must expose axis titles for assistive tech.
codes.cause: An x or y encoding has no non-empty axis title.
codes.fix: Set a meaningful title on every bound x and y channel.

codes.message: Area charts must describe baselines/ranges (requires valid extrema + table fallback).
codes.cause: An area chart lacks a ready table or numeric minimum and maximum.
codes.fix: Provide numeric area data and a table fallback that covers its range.

codes.message: Accessible tables require captions tied to the chart title.
codes.cause: The accessible table is unavailable or has an empty caption.
codes.fix: Provide a ready table fallback with a non-empty caption tied to the chart.

codes.message: Long-form description must exceed 25 characters to convey context.
codes.cause: The chart description is shorter than 25 characters.
codes.fix: Write a meaningful a11y.description of at least 25 characters.

codes.message: Charts must expose an aria-label or visible name.
codes.cause: The chart has neither a non-empty ariaLabel nor a visible name.
codes.fix: Provide a11y.ariaLabel or a non-empty chart name.

codes.cause: A line or area chart has no generated narrative summary.
codes.fix: Provide readable trend data and a narrative summary for the chart.

codes.message: Datasets with ≥3 rows must surface at least two key findings.
codes.cause: A dataset with at least three rows has fewer than two narrative findings.
codes.fix: Provide at least two findings that describe the dataset's extrema or trends.

codes.message: Every encoding field must appear in each data row.
codes.cause: An x, y or color encoding field is absent from one or more data rows.
codes.fix: Supply each bound encoding field in every row or correct the field binding.

codes.message: Dense datasets (>12 rows) require narrative aggregation.
codes.cause: A dataset with more than twelve rows has no narrative findings.
codes.fix: Summarize the dense dataset with meaningful narrative key findings.

codes.message: Deterministic column ordering must be declared when >2 columns exist.
codes.cause: The accessible table is missing or a table with more than two columns has no declared column order.
codes.fix: Provide a ready table and set portability.tableColumnOrder when it has more than two columns.

codes.message: Narrative generator must produce a ready status (three-pronged equivalence requirement).
codes.cause: The narrative generator did not produce a ready result.
codes.fix: Correct the chart data or narrative settings until narrative generation is ready.

codes.message: Filter/zoom interactions must describe their announce workflow.
codes.cause: A filter or zoom interaction has no narrative explaining announcements.
codes.fix: Set a11y.narrative.summary to describe how filter or zoom results are announced.

codes.cause: The boxes-and-arrows pre-emitter produced no catalog annotations for an entity, so it was skipped.
codes.fix: Supply the entity's Object Catalog annotations and render again.

codes.cause: Rendering a manifest entity as boxes and arrows threw an exception.
codes.fix: Correct the entity issue named in the rendering error.

codes.cause: The branded-mockup pre-emitter produced no catalog annotations for an entity, so it was skipped.
codes.fix: Supply the entity's Object Catalog annotations and render again.

codes.cause: A manifest entity or override names a brand overlay outside the supported A and B brands.
codes.fix: Use A or B for the manifest-based branded mockup.

codes.cause: Rendering a manifest entity as a branded mockup threw an exception.
codes.fix: Correct the entity or brand-token issue named in the rendering error.

codes.cause: A manifest uses a deprecated brand-prefixed alias that is accepted for one release.
codes.fix: Replace the alias with its returned canonical brand id.

codes.cause: The compose step completed without a schemaRef required by the pipeline.
codes.fix: Report the missing compose reference and retry after the compose failure is corrected.

codes.cause: Two dashboard panels have the same id.
codes.fix: Give every dashboard panel a unique id.

codes.message: A definition of this name is already registered; pass overwrite: true to replace it
codes.cause: A definition name or its destination file is already occupied.
codes.fix: Use overwrite only for an intended replacement, or rename the conflicting definition or file.

codes.message: A brand with this id already exists; create never replaces a brand
codes.cause: Brand creation requested an id already held by a brand.
codes.fix: Choose a new brand id; brand creation never replaces an existing brand.

codes.message: Imported object would replace a shipped definition
codes.cause: The accepted object shares a shipped name without its specific confirmation.
codes.fix: Review the staged object and name that exact object in confirmShipped if replacement is intended.

codes.cause: The requested fidelity fixture is not in the named fixture allowlist.
codes.fix: Choose a named fixture from the tool schema or pass an inline manifest.

codes.cause: A named fidelity fixture has no file in the installed runtime.
codes.fix: Restore the runtime fixture files or pass a valid inline manifest.

codes.cause: The request names a fidelity renderer the tool does not support.
codes.fix: Use boxes-arrows, wireframe, review or branded-mockup.

codes.cause: The request supplies no source or more than one source.
codes.fix: Supply exactly one of object, objects, schema, schemaRef, fixture or manifest.

codes.cause: The inline manifest is not an object with an entities array.
codes.fix: Pass an Object Catalog manifest containing an entities array.

codes.cause: The diagram source, object set, depth, theme or built brand fails its declared limits or token requirements.
codes.fix: Use supported inputs, reduce diagram depth or size, and restore the named built brand tokens.

codes.cause: An object relationship declaration fails the relationship contract checks.
codes.fix: Correct the reported object relationship fields before generating the diagram.

codes.cause: The composed schema exceeds diagram limits, duplicates node ids or raises an unexpected rendering error.
codes.fix: Correct duplicate ids or the reported rendering issue and reduce the composition to the named size limit.

codes.cause: The dispatch request names no registered tool.
codes.fix: Select a tool from the client's advertised tool list.

codes.cause: No saved schema exists under the requested name.
codes.fix: List saved schemas and load an existing name, or save the schema first.

codes.cause: The schemaRef is not held by this runtime session.
codes.fix: Compose or load the schema again and use its new schemaRef.

codes.cause: The schemaRef has expired.
codes.fix: Compose or load the schema again and use its fresh schemaRef.

codes.cause: The requested object name is absent from the object registry.
codes.fix: Use the suggested or listed object name, or register the intended object first.

codes.cause: The nodeId targeted by a patch is absent from the base tree.
codes.fix: Inspect the current tree and target an existing node id.

codes.cause: An artifact is missing, outside an admitted contract or fails its manifest attestation.
codes.fix: Inspect the returned kind, path and accepted contract, then supply a complete compatible artifact.

codes.cause: The structured-data component manifest is missing or unreadable during validation.
codes.fix: Restore or rebuild the structured-data manifest before relying on registry validation.

codes.cause: No component registry is available to validate the schema.
codes.fix: Restore the component registry and validate again.

codes.cause: Required token data, token CSS or the shipped token compiler kit is unavailable.
codes.fix: Restore the runtime's token assets or run the supported token build and retry.

codes.message: HTML renderer unavailable; fallback output is forbidden at build or release confidence
codes.cause: The HTML renderer is unavailable and the requested confidence forbids fallback output.
codes.fix: Restore the HTML renderer or choose an available target before requesting build or release confidence.

codes.cause: The structured-data fetch returned no components payload for a registry snapshot.
codes.fix: Restore the components structured-data payload and retry the snapshot.

codes.cause: A component is unavailable for the requested target or its release attestation is invalid.
codes.fix: Use a supported target and component, or reinstall the sealed runtime if its attestation is invalid.

codes.message: Generated artifact dependency closure is invalid
codes.cause: The generated artifact's dependencies, runtime support or application options are invalid.
codes.fix: Correct the reported dependency or application option; runnable React and Vue applications require TypeScript output.

codes.cause: Code generation reported success without the required artifact envelope.
codes.fix: Report the missing artifact envelope and do not treat the pipeline as successful.

codes.cause: HTML generation was requested with Tailwind styling that the HTML target does not support.
codes.fix: Use the HTML target's supported styling or choose a React or Vue target for Tailwind output.

codes.message: brand.apply: canonical brand source is not shipped in this runtime
codes.cause: The runtime lacks the canonical brand source required by brand.apply.
codes.fix: Use a runtime containing the token compiler kit and brand source, or restore those assets.

codes.message: design.preview: no preview host is reachable; call through the HTTP bridge or the stdio adapter, or set OODS_PREVIEW_HOST_URL
codes.cause: No preview host is reachable for design.preview.
codes.fix: Call through the HTTP bridge or stdio adapter, or configure a reachable OODS_PREVIEW_HOST_URL.

codes.message: Composition or version not found in the store
codes.cause: The requested composition or version is absent from the composition store.
codes.fix: Use an existing composition version or compose a fresh view.

codes.message: No folder is set for your objects or traits (OODS_OBJECTS_DIR, OODS_TRAITS_DIR)
codes.cause: No destination folder is configured for team objects or traits.
codes.fix: Set OODS_OBJECTS_DIR or OODS_TRAITS_DIR to a writable team folder.

codes.message: The brand template is not built; run the token build
codes.cause: The brand template has not been built.
codes.fix: Run the token build before requesting a brand template.

codes.message: Creating a brand needs a brands folder (OODS_BRANDS_DIR) or a source checkout, and the token build
codes.cause: Brand creation lacks a usable brands folder or source checkout and token build.
codes.fix: Configure a writable OODS_BRANDS_DIR with the supported token build available.

codes.cause: The tool's request rate limit has been exhausted.
codes.fix: Wait for the rate limit to refill and reduce the request rate.

codes.cause: The tool already has its maximum permitted concurrent requests.
codes.fix: Wait for in-flight requests to finish before retrying.

codes.cause: The review pre-emitter produced no catalog annotations for an entity, so it was skipped.
codes.fix: Supply the entity's Object Catalog annotations and render again.

codes.cause: Rendering a manifest entity for review threw an exception.
codes.fix: Correct the entity issue named in the rendering error.

codes.cause: The caller's role is not allowed to invoke the tool.
codes.fix: Use an authorized role or ask the operator to review the tool policy.

codes.cause: The tool handler exceeded its execution time limit.
codes.fix: Retry after reducing the request size or resolving the slow dependency.

codes.cause: An unexpected exception or malformed dispatch request reached the server boundary.
codes.fix: Correct malformed request data or report the incident and exception details to the runtime maintainer.

codes.cause: The component catalog or structured-data manifest could not be loaded.
codes.fix: Restore the catalog and manifest assets and retry the operation.

codes.cause: The HTML emitter failed to render the schema.
codes.fix: Inspect the rendering error and correct the schema or renderer dependency.

codes.cause: Rendering an individual UI fragment threw an exception.
codes.fix: Inspect that fragment's error and correct its node or component before rendering again.

codes.cause: A pipeline step failed without a usable issue or returned an invalid artifact or validation receipt.
codes.fix: Inspect the failed step and correct its reported artifact or receipt mismatch before rerunning the pipeline.

codes.cause: The pipeline compose step threw an unexpected exception.
codes.fix: Inspect the compose exception and correct its cause before rerunning the pipeline.

codes.cause: The pipeline validation step threw an unexpected exception.
codes.fix: Inspect the validation exception and correct its cause before rerunning the pipeline.

codes.cause: Screen rendering or the pipeline render step threw an exception.
codes.fix: Inspect the render error and correct its cause before retrying the operation.

codes.cause: The pipeline code-generation step threw an unexpected exception.
codes.fix: Inspect the code-generation exception and correct its cause before rerunning the pipeline.

codes.cause: The pipeline save step threw an unexpected exception.
codes.fix: Inspect the save error and restore a writable schema store before retrying.

codes.cause: An artifact or token path falls outside the policy's allowed location.
codes.fix: Choose a path under the allowed artifact or token directory.

codes.cause: An artifact manifest entry has an empty filename.
codes.fix: Repair the manifest entry with a non-empty safe filename.

codes.cause: An artifact manifest entry is not a safe filename.
codes.fix: Use a filename without traversal or path separators in the artifact manifest.

codes.message: Token build failed; source writes remain in place
codes.cause: The token build failed and any source writes remain in place.
codes.fix: Inspect the build output, fix the source or build environment and run the token build again.

codes.message: Payload directory is not writable; the response carries no payload
codes.cause: Generated payload files could not be written to the payload directory.
codes.fix: Choose a writable payload directory and retry generation.

codes.message: Your objects or traits folder is not writable; nothing was registered
codes.cause: The configured team object or trait folder could not be written.
codes.fix: Restore write access to the configured folder and register the definition again.

codes.message: Token build failed after a brand was created; the brand was removed
codes.cause: The token build failed after brand creation, so the new brand was removed.
codes.fix: Fix the token-build error and create the brand again.

codes.cause: The input does not satisfy the tool schema or a declared input constraint.
codes.fix: Correct the named fields using the tool schema and the returned details.

codes.cause: The handler returned a value that does not satisfy its output schema.
codes.fix: Report the incident and output-validation details to the runtime maintainer.

codes.cause: A required input is absent, or the object does not support the requested context.
codes.fix: Supply the named input or choose one of the object's supported contexts.

codes.cause: A saved schema name contains characters outside the accepted slug format.
codes.fix: Use only letters, numbers, hyphens and underscores in the schema name.

codes.cause: No code emitter is registered for the requested framework.
codes.fix: Choose a supported framework from the code.generate input schema.

codes.cause: A UI node or selected slot names a component outside the component registry.
codes.fix: Choose a component returned by catalog.list and update the node or slot.

codes.cause: The UI schema, patch result or generated target violates a structural or component contract.
codes.fix: Correct the reported schema, binding, prop, slot, event or syntax issue and generate again.

codes.cause: Two UI nodes use the same id.
codes.fix: Give every node a unique id before validating or patching the schema.

codes.cause: Neither a usable schema nor a schemaRef was supplied for the operation.
codes.fix: Pass an inline schema or obtain a fresh schemaRef by composing or loading a schema.

codes.cause: A patch operation needs a base tree but none was supplied.
codes.fix: Pass the tree to patch as baseTree, or supply the schema reference accepted by the tool.

codes.cause: Patch mode was selected without a patch payload.
codes.fix: Supply a supported patch object or array.

codes.cause: A patch path is not a valid JSON pointer.
codes.fix: Use a slash-prefixed JSON pointer with valid escape sequences.

codes.cause: A patch path contains a prohibited prototype-related segment.
codes.fix: Remove prototype-related path segments and target an ordinary data field.

codes.cause: A JSON patch operation is malformed or lacks its required members.
codes.fix: Supply a supported operation with a valid path and the value it requires.

codes.cause: A patch attempts to replace or remove the document root.
codes.fix: Patch a child path or provide a replacement schema through the full-schema route.

codes.cause: The patch path is missing or cannot be resolved in the base document.
codes.fix: Inspect the current tree and use an existing path appropriate to the operation.

codes.cause: A patch uses an invalid array index.
codes.fix: Use a valid in-range array index, or the supported append position for add.

codes.cause: Applying a validated patch threw an exception.
codes.fix: Inspect the returned path and exception, then correct the patch and base tree.

codes.cause: A patch entry is not a supported object or does not describe a valid patch shape.
codes.fix: Use either the documented JSON Patch shape or the documented node-patch shape.

codes.cause: A node-targeted patch does not name a nodeId.
codes.fix: Set nodeId to an id present in the base tree.

codes.cause: The patch array contains no operations.
codes.fix: Supply at least one patch operation.

codes.cause: The patch payload is neither an object nor an array.
codes.fix: Pass a patch object or an array of supported patch operations.

codes.cause: A brand patch uses an operation other than the supported add, replace or remove operations.
codes.fix: Use an operation supported by brand.apply.

codes.cause: A brand patch tries to remove a non-index array path.
codes.fix: Target an existing numeric array index for removal.

codes.cause: A token delta or patch contains a prohibited prototype-related key.
codes.fix: Remove the unsafe key and use ordinary token keys.

codes.cause: One patch array mixes JSON Patch entries and node-targeted entries.
codes.fix: Split the request or use one patch format throughout the array.

codes.cause: JSON Patch mode received an object instead of an array of operations.
codes.fix: Wrap the JSON Patch operations in an array.

codes.cause: The layout resolver has low confidence in the inferred layout.
codes.fix: Specify the intended layout or provide a clearer composition intent.

codes.cause: Composing an object reported a non-fatal trait or composition warning.
codes.fix: Read the warning and correct the named object or trait declaration if unintended.

codes.cause: Layout or slot resolution reported an ambiguity or fallback.
codes.fix: Specify the intended layout or component selection using the returned warning.

codes.message: Component registry or object view-extension issue
codes.cause: The generated schema names unregistered components, or the object has no view extensions for the requested context.
codes.fix: Use registered components and a context with the intended object view extensions.

codes.message: Object view extension could not fill a slot
codes.cause: A trait view extension names an unregistered component or has no matching slot in the chosen layout.
codes.fix: Use a registered component and a slot or position supported by the chosen layout.

codes.cause: The composed object declares a maturity other than stable, so its output may change.
codes.fix: Use a stable object for production compositions or explicitly accept the declared maturity.

codes.message: Detail tab labels are unavailable or need only one group
codes.cause: The detail context has no trait category with view extensions, or has only one category group.
codes.fix: Provide view extensions for the context or use a single-section layout when only one group exists.

codes.message: Missing or invalid viz data source
codes.cause: The visualization data source, operand or a related input option is missing or invalid.
codes.fix: Provide the required rows or typed operand and correct the field or option named in the message.

codes.cause: The dataset reference has expired.
codes.fix: Fetch the dataset again and retry with the new reference or inline rows.

codes.message: Dataset reference resolved to empty or non-array rows
codes.cause: The dataset reference resolves to empty data or a value that is not a row array.
codes.fix: Provide a non-empty row array or fetch a dataset that contains rows.

codes.cause: The chart spec or typed data operand fails its supported input contract.
codes.fix: Correct the chart spec or operand according to the returned validation message.

codes.cause: The Vega-Lite adapter could not compile the chart spec.
codes.fix: Correct the unsupported spec structure reported by the compiler and render again.

codes.cause: The ECharts adapter could not compile the chart operand.
codes.fix: Correct the operand or unsupported chart structure reported by the adapter.

codes.cause: Chart rendering or certification failed after input handling.
codes.fix: Inspect the returned rendering error and retry after correcting its cause.

codes.cause: A governed measure reference does not resolve in the measure registry.
codes.fix: Use an existing measure reference or register the intended governed measure.

codes.cause: With strict field checks enabled, a referenced field is absent from every dataset row.
codes.fix: Correct the field name or supply rows containing that field.

codes.cause: The governed measure registry cannot be read as a valid registry.
codes.fix: Repair the measure registry using its schema before rendering governed panels.

codes.cause: A non-additive governed measure was requested with a sum rollup.
codes.fix: Use the governed measure's supported aggregate instead of summing it.

codes.message: Geo join: corridor has no matching map feature
codes.cause: A geographic join key has no matching map feature under strict field checks.
codes.fix: Correct the join key or crosswalk so each intended row matches a map feature.

codes.message: Brand token pair fails WCAG contrast
codes.cause: An enabled contrast scan found a brand-token color pair below its required contrast.
codes.fix: Adjust the named brand-token pair and rerun the contrast scan.

codes.cause: A token overlay value is empty, malformed or contains unsafe CSS or HTML characters.
codes.fix: Supply a safe CSS color, length or number without forbidden syntax.

codes.message: KPI panel has no resolvable field (measureRef unresolved)
codes.cause: A KPI panel has no field after governed-measure resolution.
codes.fix: Set a field or enable measure resolution with a valid measureRef.

codes.cause: A governed measure's expected time grain differs from the panel data or cannot be checked.
codes.fix: Provide the required periodField and data at the governed measure's expected grain.

codes.cause: With strict dataset checks enabled, a KPI panel names an unknown dataset.
codes.fix: Use a datasetId present in the request's datasets array.

codes.cause: A measured style delta names a logical key absent from the style-library mapping.
codes.fix: Use a registered logical key or add its supported mapping in the style library.

codes.message: Measure-narrative context drifts from the resolved governed measure
codes.cause: The panel's threshold value differs from the governed threshold described by its narrative.
codes.fix: Align or remove the threshold override, or omit the governed narrative.

codes.message: Measure-narrative threshold direction drifts from the resolved governed measure
codes.cause: The panel's threshold direction differs from the governed direction described by its narrative.
codes.fix: Align or remove the direction override, or omit the governed narrative.

codes.message: Color range is shorter than the number of series (colors will recycle)
codes.cause: The explicit categorical color range has fewer colors than distinct series.
codes.fix: Provide enough distinct colors or reduce the number of series.

codes.message: Color range contains a non-hex color
codes.cause: An explicit color-range entry is not a valid hexadecimal color.
codes.fix: Replace each invalid range entry with a valid hexadecimal color.

codes.message: Color range is not supported on this chart type (cartesian color channel only)
codes.cause: An explicit cartesian color range was supplied to a chart type that cannot consume it.
codes.fix: Remove the range or choose a chart type that supports a cartesian color channel.

codes.message: Categorical palette recycles: more distinct color groups than the 6-slot OODS palette
codes.cause: An ECharts categorical chart has more groups than the six available palette slots.
codes.fix: Reduce or group the categories before relying on color to distinguish them.

codes.cause: A chord or force-graph link names a node absent from the node set.
codes.fix: Add the missing node or correct the link endpoint.

codes.cause: A chord or force-graph operand repeats a directed source-target link.
codes.fix: Merge duplicate directed links while retaining intentional reciprocal links.

codes.message: Delta addresses a different brand than the one being applied
codes.cause: A measured token delta names a different brand from the brand being applied.
codes.fix: Apply the delta to its recorded brand or supply a delta for the intended brand.

codes.message: A bar's value axis is not a linear zero-anchored scale
codes.cause: A bar's value axis is not linear and anchored at zero.
codes.fix: Use a linear zero-anchored scale for a bar's value axis.

codes.message: Layered marks resolve a positional scale independently (dual axis)
codes.cause: Layers sharing one plot frame resolve a positional scale independently.
codes.fix: Share the positional scale or put the series into separate panels.

codes.message: An area's value axis is not a linear zero-anchored scale
codes.cause: A non-ranged area's value axis is not linear and anchored at zero.
codes.fix: Use a linear zero-anchored scale for the area value axis.

codes.message: A row-collapsing aggregation is not disclosed on any declared text surface
codes.cause: An aggregation merges rows without disclosure in the chart description, title or aggregated-axis title.
codes.fix: Name the aggregation on at least one of those text surfaces.

codes.message: A treemap/sunburst node value cannot be encoded as area or angle
codes.cause: A treemap or sunburst node has a negative or non-finite value that area cannot represent.
codes.fix: Supply finite non-negative magnitude values for hierarchy nodes.

codes.message: An explicit treemap/sunburst parent value is not the sum of its children
codes.cause: An explicit treemap or sunburst parent value differs from the sum of its children.
codes.fix: Make the parent total equal its children or omit the explicit parent value.

codes.message: A sankey/chord link value is negative or non-finite
codes.cause: A sankey or chord link has a negative or non-finite magnitude.
codes.fix: Supply finite non-negative link values.

codes.message: A sankey node's height does not match the flow its links carry
codes.cause: A sankey node's drawn height does not agree with the flow carried by its links.
codes.fix: Correct the explicit node value or the incoming and outgoing flow totals.

codes.message: A sankey directed flow appears more than once
codes.cause: A sankey operand repeats a directed source-target link.
codes.fix: Merge duplicate directed links so each route is represented once.

codes.message: A choropleth region matched rows with conflicting joined values
codes.cause: Multiple choropleth rows join to the same region with conflicting encoded values.
codes.fix: Aggregate or reconcile the rows to one encoded value per region.

codes.message: KPI numeric aggregate over a field with no numeric cells
codes.cause: A numeric KPI aggregate received non-null values but none are numeric.
codes.fix: Provide numeric cells or use count or distinct for non-numeric data.

codes.message: Baked categorical palette recycles: more distinct series than palette slots
codes.cause: The applied default categorical palette has fewer slots than distinct series.
codes.fix: Supply a sufficiently long explicit color range or reduce the series count.

codes.message: Required hash-bound release evidence is missing; references are not re-executed
codes.cause: The release profile is missing readable passed evidence bound to the generated artifact.
codes.fix: Provide each required local JSON evidence file with its passed status and matching hashes.

codes.message: Release evidence artifact hash mismatch; references are not re-executed
codes.cause: A release evidence file or its declared artifact hash does not match the generated artifact.
codes.fix: Regenerate the evidence for these exact artifact bytes and update both hashes.

codes.cause: A UI node declares a workflow state outside the canonical state vocabulary.
codes.fix: Use a supported UI workflow state in the node's state field.

codes.cause: Rendering the compiled chart to SVG failed.
codes.fix: Inspect the SVG rendering error and correct the spec or rendering environment.

codes.message: viz.render pattern conflicts with explicit data or source identity/presentation overrides
codes.cause: A pattern request overrides data, identity or presentation owned by the source pattern.
codes.fix: Remove the conflicting options or render an explicit chart instead of a pattern.

codes.message: viz.render pattern is authoring-only because its source structure is not supported by the public renderer
codes.cause: The selected pattern has source structure the public renderer does not support.
codes.fix: Use its authoring source or select a publicly renderable pattern.

codes.message: artifact.certify: bubble-map size is negative or non-finite
codes.cause: A bubble-map row has a negative or non-finite size magnitude.
codes.fix: Supply finite non-negative size values.

codes.message: artifact.certify: bubble-map magnitudes use radius rather than area scaling
codes.cause: The emitted bubble diameter scales with magnitude instead of its area doing so.
codes.fix: Choose an encoding that preserves magnitude by area; the current public bubble builder exposes no size-scale override.

codes.message: artifact.certify: overlapping bubble-map rows have conflicting encoded values
codes.cause: Bubble-map rows at the same coordinates have conflicting encoded values.
codes.fix: Aggregate or separate the rows so one point does not conceal a different value.

codes.message: artifact.certify: flow-map strength is negative or non-finite
codes.cause: A flow-map route has a negative or non-finite strength.
codes.fix: Supply finite non-negative route strengths.

codes.message: artifact.certify: a directed geographic flow appears more than once
codes.cause: The geographic operand repeats the same directed route between coordinates.
codes.fix: Merge duplicate directed routes while retaining intentional reciprocal flows.

codes.message: artifact.certify: a force-graph directed edge appears more than once
codes.cause: A force-graph operand repeats a directed source-target edge.
codes.fix: Merge duplicate directed edges while retaining intentional reciprocal edges.

codes.message: viz.render: pattern retired; use the named supported alternative
codes.cause: The requested pattern has been retired from public rendering.
codes.fix: Use the supported alternative named in the returned message.

codes.message: viz.render: static SVG shows the default selection state
codes.cause: A chart with interactions was rendered to static SVG in its default selection state.
codes.fix: Use a client renderer to provide the declared interactive behavior.

codes.cause: map.apply received neither or both of report and reportPath.
codes.fix: Provide exactly one of report or reportPath.

codes.cause: The structured-data request combines unsupported options or omits a required runPath.
codes.fix: Use the reported fetch-kind contract and provide its required path and supported options.

codes.message: Composition id or version is not well-formed
codes.cause: A composition id, version or required composition selector is missing or malformed.
codes.fix: Use an existing cmp- identifier and a positive integer version, or provide the required fresh composition inputs.

codes.message: Composition edit not applicable to this version
codes.cause: An edit or ordering preference cannot apply to the stored composition version.
codes.fix: Read that version's recorded choices and submit an edit valid for its regions, fields and components.

codes.cause: The requested composition version cannot be accepted under the acceptance checks.
codes.fix: Correct the acceptance issue named in the response before accepting the version.

codes.message: Context item is malformed or cannot state its provenance
codes.cause: A context item or search record lacks required content or valid provenance.
codes.fix: Supply the named provenance fields, valid timestamps and readable body or excerpt within the item limit.

codes.message: Context item names a different object from the one on screen
codes.cause: A context item names an object other than the one shown by the composition.
codes.fix: Attach context for the displayed object or compose the intended object.

codes.message: Observation run path is not one Stage1 run
codes.cause: The observation path does not identify one Stage1 capture run.
codes.fix: Point the observation path at the directory containing one run's manifest.json.

codes.message: Observation artifact schema_version is outside the accepted contract
codes.cause: An observation artifact declares a version outside OODS Foundry's admitted contract.
codes.fix: Use an admitted artifact version or wait for its contract to be reviewed and supported.

codes.message: Observation names an object the registry does not hold
codes.cause: The observation comparison names an object absent from the object registry.
codes.fix: Register the intended object or use an object already held by the registry.

codes.message: Result state bound to a component that cannot be held to the result family
codes.cause: A result-state field is bound to a component that cannot preserve the result visual family.
codes.fix: Use a Badge or StatusBadge with the result tone, or render the value as plain text.

codes.message: Run view path is not one Stage1 run
codes.cause: The run-view path does not identify a Stage1 run with the required manifest shape.
codes.fix: Point runPath at one capture's manifest directory rather than a suite or analysis directory.

codes.message: Run view artifact is outside the admitted contract
codes.cause: A run-view artifact is outside the admitted contract or changed during reading.
codes.fix: Use a complete unchanged run with admitted versions and matching manifest attestations.

codes.message: Run does not match the composition it is shown in
codes.cause: The requested run, analysis, record or presentation does not match the composition being shown.
codes.fix: Compose a fresh supported view for that source and use a record id belonging to it.

codes.message: Definition not registered: it does not validate or compose
codes.cause: An object or trait definition does not validate or compose, including a declared unbound trait conflict or an invalid semantic version.
codes.fix: Fix the reported problems before registering again: remove one conflicting unbound trait or use a semantic version such as 1.2.3 when those checks fail.

codes.message: Brand does not validate; nothing was written
codes.cause: The proposed brand fails validation, including its required color contrast.
codes.fix: Correct the reported brand fields and contrast pairs before applying or creating it.

codes.message: Mapped component package cannot be previewed
codes.cause: The preview host cannot resolve, compile or freeze a mapped component package.
codes.fix: Install a compatible mapped package in the preview environment and correct its imports or build errors.

codes.message: Team component mapping has advisory limits
codes.cause: A mapped team component has unmet shared contract obligations, or a React-only shadcn mapping does not apply to Vue or HTML output, which keeps the OODS Foundry component.
codes.fix: For unmet obligations, read the component-contract report and address them before shipping. For a React-only shadcn mapping, generate React output to use the mapping or keep the OODS Foundry component in Vue or HTML output.

codes.cause: A mapping entry conflicts with another mapping or its local package does not resolve at the pinned name, version and export.
codes.fix: Correct the named entry using its index, id and reason, then submit the complete list again. No mapping was written.

codes.message: Object import refused or rolled back
codes.cause: Source, references, staging integrity, accepted proposals or composed batch failed validation.
codes.fix: Read the source pointer or rollback details, correct the input, draft again and explicitly accept the intended objects.

codes.message: Fragment output ignores document scope options
codes.cause: Fragment output was requested with document-only options.
codes.fix: Request document output to apply those options, or remove them for fragments.

codes.message: Non-strict fragments reclassify unknown-component errors per node
codes.cause: Non-strict fragment rendering moved unknown-component failures to individual nodes.
codes.fix: Replace the unknown components or inspect each fragment error before using the output.

codes.message: A dry-run render returns no HTML
codes.cause: The render ran as a dry run and returned validation without HTML.
codes.fix: Set apply to true to receive rendered HTML.

codes.message: A large output was written to files
codes.cause: No payload mode was chosen and the output would exceed 100,000 characters, more than one reply should carry.
codes.fix: Read the files the payload block lists, or pass payloadMode "inline" to receive the output in the response.

codes.cause: The wireframe pre-emitter produced no catalog annotations for an entity, so it was skipped.
codes.fix: Supply the entity's Object Catalog annotations and render again.

codes.cause: Rendering a manifest entity as a wireframe threw an exception.
codes.fix: Correct the entity issue named in the rendering error.

notes: Aliases list historical spellings for lookup and migration only; results emit the canonical code, never its aliases.

Tools lists which tools can return a code, by static analysis of the shipped built module graph, including transitive tool calls; shared modules may make the list broader than an individual call path. It includes the on-demand a11y_scan tool.
Message is the canonical registry message (or accessibility rule summary); the runtime adds request-specific details at the emitting call site.

Severity is error-or-warning where a code has both outcomes, including dashboard panel omission and advisory code-generation profiles; accessibility rules retain their intrinsic evaluator severity, while their returned-code severity includes panel omission.
Reserved codes have no current emitter. OODS-N019 is retired and occurs only in historical tool-ledger evidence.

The optional HTTP bridge has its own transport codes outside this MCP glossary: POLICY_DENIED, RATE_LIMITED, TIMEOUT, VALIDATION_ERROR and RUN_ERROR; legacy bridge aliases are normalized to those codes.
